ESV.1: “You shall not spread a false report. You shall not join hands with a wicked man to be a malicious witness.
ESV.2: You shall not fall in with the many to do evil, nor shall you bear witness in a lawsuit, siding with the many, so as to pervert justice,
ESV.3: nor shall you be partial to a poor man in his lawsuit.
ESV.4: “If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, you shall bring it back to him.
ESV.5: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying down under its burden, you shall refrain from leaving him with it; you shall rescue it with him.
ESV.6: “You shall not pervert the justice due to your poor in his lawsuit.
ESV.7: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent and righteous, for I will not acquit the wicked.
ESV.8: And you shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.
ESV.9: “You shall not oppress a sojourner. You know the heart of a sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
ESV.10: “For six years you shall sow your land and gather in its yield,
ESV.11: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the beasts of the field may eat. You shall do likewise with your vineyard, and with your olive orchard.
ESV.12: “Six days you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant woman, and the alien, may be refreshed.
ESV.13: “Pay attention to all that I have said to you, and make no mention of the names of other gods, nor let it be heard on your lips.
ESV.14: “Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to me.
ESV.15: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. As I commanded you, you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. None shall appear before me empty-handed.
ESV.16: You shall keep the Feast of Harvest, of the firstfruits of your labor, of what you sow in the field. You shall keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in from the field the fruit of your labor.
ESV.17: Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord GOD.
ESV.18: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the fat of my feast remain until the morning.
ESV.19: “The best of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
ESV.20: “Behold, I send an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared.
ESV.21: Pay careful attention to him and obey his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgression, for my name is in him.
ESV.22: “But if you carefully obey his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
ESV.23: “When my angel goes before you and brings you to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, and I blot them out,
ESV.24: you shall not bow down to their gods nor serve them, nor do as they do, but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their pillars in pieces.
ESV.25: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he  will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
ESV.26: None shall miscarry or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
ESV.27: I will send my terror before you and will throw into confusion all the people against whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
ESV.28: And I will send hornets  before you, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.
ESV.29: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you.
ESV.30: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and possess the land.
ESV.31: And I will set your border from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates,  for I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
ESV.32: You shall make no covenant with them and their gods.
ESV.33: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me; for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

NASB.1: 'You shall not bear a false report; do not join your hand with a wicked man to be a malicious witness.
NASB.2: 'You shall not follow the masses in doing evil, nor shall you testify in a dispute so as to turn aside after a multitude in order to pervert [justice];
NASB.3: nor shall you be partial to a poor man in his dispute.
NASB.4: 'If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey wandering away, you shall surely return it to him.
NASB.5: 'If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying [helpless] under its load, you shall refrain from leaving it to him, you shall surely release [it] with him.
NASB.6: 'You shall not pervert the justice [due] to your needy [brother] in his dispute.
NASB.7: 'Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent or the righteous, for I will not acquit the guilty.
NASB.8: 'You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of the just.
NASB.9: 'You shall not oppress a stranger, since you yourselves know the feelings of a stranger, for you [also] were strangers in the land of Egypt.
NASB.10: 'You shall sow your land for six years and gather in its yield,
NASB.11: but [on] the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, so that the needy of your people may eat; and whatever they leave the beast of the field may eat. You are to do the same with your vineyard [and] your olive grove.
NASB.12: 'Six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you shall cease [from labor] so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female slave, as well as your stranger, may refresh themselves.
NASB.13: 'Now concerning everything which I have said to you, be on your guard; and do not mention the name of other gods, nor let [them] be heard from your mouth.
NASB.14: 'Three times a year you shall celebrate a feast to Me.
NASB.15: 'You shall observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. And none shall appear before Me empty-handed.
NASB.16: 'Also [you shall observe] the Feast of the Harvest [of] the first fruits of your labors [from] what you sow in the field; also the Feast of the Ingathering at the end of the year when you gather in [the fruit of] your labors from the field.
NASB.17: 'Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
NASB.18: 'You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; nor is the fat of My feast to remain overnight until morning.
NASB.19: 'You shall bring the choice first fruits of your soil into the house of the LORD your God. 'You are not to boil a young goat in the milk of its mother.
NASB.20: 'Behold, I am going to send an angel before you to guard you along the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
NASB.21: 'Be on your guard before him and obey his voice; do not be rebellious toward him, for he will not pardon your transgression, since My name is in him.
NASB.22: 'But if you truly obey his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
NASB.23: 'For My angel will go before you and bring you in to [the land of] the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I will completely destroy them.
NASB.24: 'You shall not worship their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their deeds; but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their [sacred] pillars in pieces.
NASB.25: 'But you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water; and I will remove sickness from your midst.
NASB.26: 'There shall be no one miscarrying or barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
NASB.27: 'I will send My terror ahead of you, and throw into confusion all the people among whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn [their] backs to you.
NASB.28: 'I will send hornets ahead of you so that they will drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites before you.
NASB.29: 'I will not drive them out before you in a single year, that the land may not become desolate and the beasts of the field become too numerous for you.
NASB.30: 'I will drive them out before you little by little, until you become fruitful and take possession of the land.
NASB.31: 'I will fix your boundary from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River [Euphrates]; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
NASB.32: 'You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
NASB.33: 'They shall not live in your land, because they will make you sin against Me; for [if] you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.'

NKJV.1: “You shall not circulate a false report. Do not put your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
NKJV.2: You shall not follow a crowd to do evil; nor shall you testify in a dispute so as to turn aside after many to pervert justice.
NKJV.3: You shall not show partiality to a poor man in his dispute.
NKJV.4: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
NKJV.5: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying under its burden, and you would refrain from helping it, you shall surely help him with it.
NKJV.6: “You shall not pervert the judgment of your poor in his dispute.
NKJV.7: Keep yourself far from a false matter; do not kill the innocent and righteous. For I will not justify the wicked.
NKJV.8: And you shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the discerning and perverts the words of the righteous.
NKJV.9: “Also you shall not oppress a stranger, for you know the heart of a stranger, because you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
NKJV.10: “Six years you shall sow your land and gather in its produce,
NKJV.11: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave, the beasts of the field may eat. In like manner you shall do with your vineyard and your olive grove.
NKJV.12: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female servant and the stranger may be refreshed.
NKJV.13: “And in all that I have said to you, be circumspect and make no mention of the name of other gods, nor let it be heard from your mouth.
NKJV.14: “Three times you shall keep a feast to Me in the year:
NKJV.15: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt; none shall appear before Me empty);
NKJV.16: and the Feast of Harvest, the firstfruits of your labors which you have sown in the field; and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you have gathered in the fruit of your labors from the field.
NKJV.17: “Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
NKJV.18: “You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; nor shall the fat of My sacrifice remain until morning.
NKJV.19: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
NKJV.20: “Behold, I send an Angel before you to keep you in the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
NKJV.21: Beware of Him and obey His voice; do not provoke Him, for He will not pardon your transgressions; for My name is in Him.
NKJV.22: But if you indeed obey His voice and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
NKJV.23: For My Angel will go before you and bring you in to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.
NKJV.24: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their works; but you shall utterly overthrow them and completely break down their sacred pillars.
NKJV.25: “So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take sickness away from the midst of you.
NKJV.26: No one shall suffer miscarriage or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
NKJV.27: “I will send My fear before you, I will cause confusion among all the people to whom you come, and will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
NKJV.28: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before you.
NKJV.29: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the field become too numerous for you.
NKJV.30: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased, and you inherit the land.
NKJV.31: And I will set your bounds from the Red Sea to the sea, Philistia, and from the desert to the River. For I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
NKJV.32: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
NKJV.33: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

NLT.1: “You must not pass along false rumors. You must not cooperate with evil people by lying on the witness stand.
NLT.2: “You must not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you are called to testify in a dispute, do not be swayed by the crowd to twist justice.
NLT.3: And do not slant your testimony in favor of a person just because that person is poor.
NLT.4: “If you come upon your enemy’s ox or donkey that has strayed away, take it back to its owner.
NLT.5: If you see that the donkey of someone who hates you has collapsed under its load, do not walk by. Instead, stop and help.
NLT.6: “In a lawsuit, you must not deny justice to the poor.
NLT.7: “Be sure never to charge anyone falsely with evil. Never sentence an innocent or blameless person to death, for I never declare a guilty person to be innocent.
NLT.8: “Take no bribes, for a bribe makes you ignore something that you clearly see. A bribe makes even a righteous person twist the truth.
NLT.9: “You must not oppress foreigners. You know what it’s like to be a foreigner, for you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.
NLT.10: “Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
NLT.11: but let the land be renewed and lie uncultivated during the seventh year. Then let the poor among you harvest whatever grows on its own. Leave the rest for wild animals to eat. The same applies to your vineyards and olive groves.
NLT.12: “You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but on the seventh day you must stop working. This gives your ox and your donkey a chance to rest. It also allows your slaves and the foreigners living among you to be refreshed.
NLT.13: “Pay close attention to all my instructions. You must not call on the name of any other gods. Do not even speak their names.
NLT.14: “Each year you must celebrate three festivals in my honor.
NLT.15: First, celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, just as I commanded you. Celebrate this festival annually at the appointed time in early spring, in the month of Abib, for that is the anniversary of your departure from Egypt. No one may appear before me without an offering.
NLT.16: “Second, celebrate the Festival of Harvest, when you bring me the first crops of your harvest. “Finally, celebrate the Festival of the Final Harvest at the end of the harvest season, when you have harvested all the crops from your fields.
NLT.17: At these three times each year, every man in Israel must appear before the Sovereign, the LORD.
NLT.18: “You must not offer the blood of my sacrificial offerings together with any baked goods containing yeast. And do not leave the fat from the festival offerings until the next morning.
NLT.19: “As you harvest your crops, bring the very best of the first harvest to the house of the LORD your God. “You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
NLT.20: “See, I am sending an angel before you to protect you on your journey and lead you safely to the place I have prepared for you.
NLT.21: Pay close attention to him, and obey his instructions. Do not rebel against him, for he is my representative, and he will not forgive your rebellion.
NLT.22: But if you are careful to obey him, following all my instructions, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will oppose those who oppose you.
NLT.23: For my angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, so you may live there. And I will destroy them completely.
NLT.24: You must not worship the gods of these nations or serve them in any way or imitate their evil practices. Instead, you must utterly destroy them and smash their sacred pillars.
NLT.25: “You must serve only the LORD your God. If you do, I will bless you with food and water, and I will protect you from illness.
NLT.26: There will be no miscarriages or infertility in your land, and I will give you long, full lives.
NLT.27: “I will send my terror ahead of you and create panic among all the people whose lands you invade. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
NLT.28: I will send terror ahead of you to drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites.
NLT.29: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals would multiply and threaten you.
NLT.30: I will drive them out a little at a time until your population has increased enough to take possession of the land.
NLT.31: And I will fix your boundaries from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the eastern wilderness to the Euphrates River. I will hand over to you the people now living in the land, and you will drive them out ahead of you.
NLT.32: “Make no treaties with them or their gods.
NLT.33: They must not live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me. If you serve their gods, you will be caught in the trap of idolatry.”

WEB.1: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
WEB.2: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
WEB.3: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
WEB.4: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
WEB.5: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him, you shall surely help him with it.
WEB.6: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
WEB.7: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous: for I will not justify the wicked.
WEB.8: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
WEB.9: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
WEB.10: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
WEB.11: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
WEB.12: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
WEB.13: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
WEB.14: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
WEB.15: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
WEB.16: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
WEB.17: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.18: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
WEB.19: The first of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
WEB.20: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
WEB.21: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
WEB.22: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
WEB.23: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
WEB.24: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
WEB.25: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
WEB.26: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
WEB.27: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
WEB.28: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
WEB.29: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
WEB.30: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
WEB.31: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
WEB.32: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
WEB.33: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

AMP.1: "You shall not give a false report; you shall not join hands with the wicked to be a malicious witness [promoting wrong and violence].
AMP.2: You shall not follow a crowd to do [something] evil, nor shall you testify at a trial or in a dispute so as to side with a crowd in order to pervert justice;
AMP.3: nor shall you favor or be partial to a poor man in his dispute [simply because he is poor].
AMP.4: "If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey wandering off, you must bring it back to him.
AMP.5: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying helpless under its load, you shall not leave the man to deal with it [alone]; you must help him release the animal [from its burden].
AMP.6: "You shall not pervert (bend) the justice due to your poor in his dispute.
AMP.7: Keep far away from a false charge or action, and do not condemn to death the innocent or the righteous, for I will not justify and acquit the guilty.
AMP.8: "You shall not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the testimony and the cause of the righteous.
AMP.9: "You shall not oppress a stranger, for you know the soul [the feelings, thoughts, and concerns] of a stranger, for you were strangers in Egypt.
AMP.10: "You shall sow your land six years and harvest its yield,
AMP.11: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie uncultivated, so that the poor among your people may eat [what the land grows naturally]; whatever they leave the animals of the field may eat. You shall do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
AMP.12: "Six days [each week] you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall stop [working] so that your ox and your donkey may settle down and rest, and the son of your female servant, as well as your stranger, may be refreshed.
AMP.13: Now concerning everything which I have said to you, be on your guard; do not mention the name of other gods [either in a blessing or in a curse]; do not let such speech be heard [coming] from your mouth.
AMP.14: "Three times a year you shall celebrate a feast [dedicated] to Me.
AMP.15: You shall observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. No one shall appear before Me empty-handed [but you shall bring sacrificial offerings].
AMP.16: Also [you shall observe] the Feast of Harvest (Weeks, Pentecost, or First Fruits), acknowledging the first fruits of your labor, of what you sow in the field. And [third] the Feast of Ingathering (Booths or Tabernacles) at the end of the year when you gather in [the fruit of] your labors from the field.
AMP.17: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
AMP.18: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; and the fat of My feast is not to be left overnight until morning.
AMP.19:
"You shall bring the choice first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God.
"You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
AMP.20: "Behold, I am going to send an Angel before you to keep and guard you on the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
AMP.21: Be on your guard before Him, listen to and obey His voice; do not be rebellious toward Him or provoke Him, for He will not pardon your transgression, since My Name (authority) is in Him.
AMP.22: But if you will indeed listen to and truly obey His voice and do everything that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
AMP.23: When My Angel goes before you and brings you to [the land of] the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, I will reject them and completely destroy them.
AMP.24: You shall not bow down to worship their gods, nor serve them, nor do [anything] in accordance with their practices. You shall completely overthrow them and break down their [sacred] pillars and images [of pagan worship].
AMP.25: You shall serve [only] the LORD your God, and He shall bless your bread and water. I will also remove sickness from among you.
AMP.26: No one shall suffer miscarriage or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
AMP.27: I will send My terror ahead of you, and I will throw into confusion all the people among whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you [in flight].
AMP.28: I will send hornets ahead of you which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite before you.
AMP.29: I will not drive them out before you in a single year, so that the land does not become desolate [due to lack of attention] and the [wild] animals of the field do not become too numerous for you.
AMP.30: I will drive them out before you little by little, until you have increased and are strong enough to take possession of the land.
AMP.31: I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines (the Mediterranean), and from the wilderness to the River Euphrates; for I will hand over the residents of the land to you, and you shall drive them out before you.
AMP.32: You shall not make a covenant with them or with their gods.
AMP.33: They shall not live in your land, because they will make you sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, it is certain to be a trap for you [resulting in judgment]."

God’s Angel to Prepare the Way
“See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
NIV.21: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.
NIV.22: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.
NIV.23: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
NIV.24: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.
NIV.25: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,
NIV.26: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.
NIV.27: “I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.
NIV.28: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
NIV.29: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.
NIV.30: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.
NIV.31: “I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River. I will hand over to you the people who live in the land and you will drive them out before you.
NIV.32: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.
NIV.33: Do not let them live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you.”

NET.1: “You must not give a false report. Do not make common cause with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
NET.2: “You must not follow a crowd in doing evil things; in a lawsuit you must not offer testimony that agrees with a crowd so as to pervert justice,
NET.3: and you must not show partiality to a poor man in his lawsuit.
NET.4: “If you encounter your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, you must by all means return it to him.
NET.5: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen under its load, you must not ignore him, but be sure to help him with it.
NET.6: “You must not turn away justice for your poor people in their lawsuits.
NET.7: Keep your distance from a false charge — do not kill the innocent and the righteous, for I will not justify the wicked.
NET.8: “You must not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and subverts the words of the righteous.
NET.9: “You must not oppress a foreigner, since you know the life of a foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
NET.10: “For six years you are to sow your land and gather in its produce.
NET.11: But in the seventh year you must let it lie fallow and leave it alone so that the poor of your people may eat, and what they leave any animal in the field may eat; you must do likewise with your vineyard and your olive grove.
NET.12: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, in order that your ox and your donkey may rest and that your female servant’s son and any hired help may refresh themselves.
NET.13: “Pay attention to do everything I have told you, and do not even mention the names of other gods — do not let them be heard on your lips.
NET.14: “Three times in the year you must make a pilgrim feast to me.
NET.15: You are to observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread; seven days you must eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you, at the appointed time of the month of Abib, for at that time you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before me empty-handed.
NET.16: “You are also to observe the Feast of Harvest, the firstfruits of your labors that you have sown in the field, and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year when you have gathered in your harvest out of the field.
NET.17: At three times in the year all your males will appear before the Lord GOD.
NET.18: “You must not offer the blood of my sacrifice with bread containing yeast; the fat of my festal sacrifice must not remain until morning.
NET.19: The first of the firstfruits of your soil you must bring to the house of the LORD your God. “You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
NET.20: “I am going to send an angel before you to protect you as you journey and to bring you into the place that I have prepared.
NET.21: Take heed because of him, and obey his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgressions, for my name is in him.
NET.22: But if you diligently obey him and do all that I command, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will be an adversary to your adversaries.
NET.23: For my angel will go before you and bring you to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and I will destroy them completely.
NET.24: “You must not bow down to their gods; you must not serve them or do according to their practices. Instead you must completely overthrow them and smash their standing stones to pieces.
NET.25: You must serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will remove sickness from your midst.
NET.26: No woman will miscarry her young or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
NET.27: “I will send my terror before you, and I will destroy all the people whom you encounter; I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
NET.28: I will send hornets before you that will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite before you.
NET.29: I will not drive them out before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild animals multiply against you.
NET.30: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you become fruitful and inherit the land.
NET.31: I will set your boundaries from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River, for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
NET.32: “You must make no covenant with them or with their gods.
NET.33: They must not live in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
